title: Inspect a schematic before gathering materials
summary: Measure the footprint, inspect hidden collection layers and estimate survival materials from a schematic.

body.text: Use Schemalook’s quick preview to open a .litematic, .schem, .schematic or structure .nbt locally. Schemat.io also accepts .mcstructure and direct schematic URLs. A Bedrock .mcworld such as B172 is a playable world and should be imported in Minecraft.
Inspect the collection system before laying foundations

items: Rotate the full model and locate its input and output. Measure the footprint with Schemalook’s ruler. Leave room beside the output to open storage and reach the collection line.
Switch to layer mode. Start at the lowest occupied layer and advance upward until you see where the harvested items land. Record its height relative to the foundation.
Read the block list, then add materials for any storage or access paths outside the schematic. Check the creator’s instructions for items that must be placed inside containers during setup.
Build a single module and follow one item into storage. If the blocks match but the item stops, inspect the component facing and startup settings at that point before repeating the module.

body.label: Load the schematic in Minecraft Java
